supported_option_audit.failure_option: --continue-on-error is the only failure-mode option; omitted in every production-flags probe. No --fail-fast or --kill-others option appears in complete actual binary help.
supported_option_audit.other_options: --timeout bounds entire run; explicitly probed. --raw serializes tasks and cannot provide required overlap.
supported_option_audit.task_dependencies: v2026.10.11 official reference says wait_for only waits already scheduled tasks; depends_post runs cleanup after started parent even on failure. Supplemental probes include depends_post to inspect actual failure behavior. Neither declarative edge is a generic descendant reaper.

attempt1_harness_correction.issue: With custom MISE_CONFIG_FILE and isolated config directory, mise task working directory resolved /home/agent instead of requested case cwd. Initial instrumentation wrote five solely owned temporary files there.
attempt1_harness_correction.correction: Retained those exact files under scratch/attempt1; later leaves anchor every write to explicit absolute PROBE_CASE_DIR. No repository source changed. First attempt produced no claims and was rerun.

conclusion.minimum_version_verified: 2026.10.11 only; actualbinarySHA/version retained. No older floor inferred.
conclusion.supported: jobs1/jobs2 and dependency ordering, default failure status37, direct plain sibling cancellation, forced no-task-cache execution, --skip-tools no installation and disabled exec auto-install refusal.
conclusion.concrete_missing_guarantee: Descendant cleanup/reaping: direct-exec failed-sibling test cancels task parent but sleep12 descendant survives at8s watchdog; --timeout2s returns1 while that owned descendant remains live. SIGTERM-to-mise shell-leaf case similarly leaves task/descendant.
conclusion.bounded_observation: 8s/5s watchdogs do not prove mise never cancels; they demonstrate no cleanup within the measured admission interval. Current task requirement needs owned descendants dead/reaped before return; timeout and SIGTERM return cases concretely violate that.
conclusion.minimal_native_requirement: Retain mise as sole DAG/scheduler; native supervision must own cancellation/process descendants, release resource admission after cleanup, and preserve failed-stage37 independently of timeout/collateral cancellation. No second scheduler justified.
conclusion.cleanup: Probe enabled Linux child subreaper and cleaned only its own setsid mise group and exact recorded leaf/sleep PIDs, then waitpid-reaped adopted children. Every recorded owned PID is nonlive after cleanup.
conclusion.production_evidence_limit: These are isolated tool capability controls, not current gate/quick/standalone suite passes.
